# AI-DLC — AI-Driven Development Life Cycle

Run `/aidlc` to start or resume a workflow. Describe what to build and scope is auto-detected.

**78 stages across 7 phases** (contract-first, self-healing, adversarial verification):

| Phase          | Stages        | Focus                                                    |
|----------------|---------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| INITIALIZATION | 0.1–0.3 (3)   | Bootstrap state, scaffold dirs, detect workspace         |
| IDEATION       | 1.1–1.7 (7)   | Validate intent, scope, feasibility, mockups             |
| INCEPTION      | 2.1–2.8 (8)   | Practices, requirements, design, units, delivery plan    |
| CONSTRUCTION   | 3.1–3.98 (26) | Contract-gen, code-gen, verify, quality gates, hardening |
| OPERATION      | 4.1–5.08 (24) | Deploy, validate, chaos, DR, capacity, maintenance, gov  |

**Scopes** (INIT always runs):

| Scope          | Depth         | Stages Execute                                 |
|----------------|---------------|------------------------------------------------|
| enterprise     | Comprehensive | ALL 78 stages                                  |
| feature        | Standard      | ~70 stages (skip some governance)              |
| mvp            | Standard      | ~45 stages (skip late operation, governance)   |
| poc            | Minimal       | ~12 stages (core build loop only)              |
| bugfix         | Minimal       | ~10 stages (fix + verify)                      |
| workshop       | Standard      | ~65 stages (full build, skip maintenance)      |

**Key Capabilities:**
- Contract-first: tests generated BEFORE code (code targets contracts)
- Self-healing: auto-fix findings up to 3 attempts, then escalate
- Adversarial: separate agent tries to break the system (fuzz, race, exhaust)
- Observability: per-stage telemetry, workflow summary, real-time events
- Learning: loads lessons from prior runs as constraints

**Tips**
- Describe your task in plain English — scope is auto-detected
- Run `/aidlc --status` to check progress at any time
- Run `/aidlc --stage <id>` or `/aidlc --phase <name>` to jump ahead
- Run `/aidlc --help` for full usage
